request: 좀 더 다양한 상황에서 해볼래? 처음 시작하는 위치가 고정된 게 아니어도 가능하게
training: 483 independent reset RGB calibration pairs with privileged teacher labels; 6 physical teacher trajectories tested separately and may supplement training. Static resets are not physical successes.
controller: Independent learned RGB command and readiness per robot/stage; yaw -> lateral -> yaw -> forward; one active wheel axis per phase. Two consecutive fresh stationary confirmations within four captures; all axes rechecked before existing RGB grasp.
runtime_boundary: Own RGB, fixed top RGB, saved models, own issued commands, phase/history only; no truth, velocity, contacts or setup pose feedback. Fixed top image crop per robot lane preserves rawcamera geometry.
teacher_boundary: Truth allowed only in collection labels and teacher controller, never student decision inputs.

final_comparison.paired_baseline: prior learned forward-only RGB approach from modelv2, same starts and exact physics/RGB

acceptance.grasp: height>=.03m with bilateral contact and weld off continuously>=2s

storage: Source committed before each run and frozen throughout each cohort. All failures retained. Video raw local unless explicitly archived. No Drive.
